items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Even with the little band I had when I was with him, he had -- he used Billy Kyle as a musical director.

ctx.x: I know once with his big band he had Joe Garland, the saxophone player, the guy who wrote In the Mood. He had
Joe Garland to conduct his band, and Louis -- Lou Russell used to be his musical director. Even with the little band I had when I was with him, he had -- he used Billy Kyle as a musical director.

For instance, if we went in a town and Louie had to rehearse for a TV show or something, well, Billy was -- Louie didn't have to go out, but Louie could go home and relax. Billy would go and tell them what songs Louie was doing, and most of the stars do it that way, you know, and they don't fool around there all day doing that.
